summary.text: FLÅM BUSSERVICE AS is a Norwegian limited company (aksjeselskap) registered for passenger transport outside timetables, with its registered activity listed as bus transport. The company had 11 employees in the register as of 2026-10-13, and its latest filed annual accounts are for 2025. For 2025, sales revenue was 22540285 NOK and the annual result was 3970718 NOK, with total equity of 697181 NOK and total debt of 8583232 NOK. The company is 100% owned by its direct parent FLÅM INVESTOR AS, and it is part of a group. Jørund Vidme is listed as daglig leder (managing director) and Ragnar Vidme as chair of the board, and the company is based at Flåmsdalsvegen 5B in FLÅM. The register shows a headcount change to 12 employees dated 2026-08-12, and the company was formerly named FLÅM BILUTLEIE AS until 2026-04-28.
